dedupe_keys.name: a high resolution global land daily drought index dataset during 1979 2022

description: Zhang, Duan, Cherubini and Ma publish daily evapotranspiration deficit index (DEDI) grids for global land from 1979 through 2022. Zenodo lists 44 yearly NetCDF files under CC BY 4.0 at a stated 0.25-degree resolution. The index derives from ERA5 actual and potential evapotranspiration; the authors describe its use to track the timing and severity of ecological or agricultural drought. Infrastructure modellers could apply the series to water-demand, hydropower or food-supply hazard scenarios, with local calibration. A related catalogue record covers an earlier Science Data Bank DEDI release ending in 2020. This Zenodo DOI supplies two later years and is a separate published release; its cross-repository version lineage is not explicitly stated. A limitation is that ERA5-derived drought patterns inherit reanalysis biases, and an ecological drought index does not directly measure reservoir inflow or crop losses. No NetCDF was downloaded, so field names, missing cells and daily values were not checked.
